firm_note.text: Amplify Financial, LLC (branded 'Amplify') is the RIA-facing entity of Amplify, the AI-native wealth management technology platform co-founded by Aaron Brodt and Ron Shurts that has grown to over $18B in AUM on the platform. Aaron Brodt is also the founder of Ashton Thomas Private Wealth (part of Arax Investment Partners/RedBird Capital) — the same acquirer that took on Pinnacle Peak Private Client Group (CRD 282003) in March 2026, per this batch's other findings. UNRESOLVED OWNERSHIP FLAG: Schedule B lists 'Amplify Ventures Group, LLC' as a 75%+ owner. Arizona Corporation Commission filings (Document #23602353, formed 11/3/2023) show Amplify Ventures Group, LLC's sole listed Member is 'Hana Holdings, LLC' (Maricopa County, AZ). No public filing or press source directly ties Ron Shurts to Hana Holdings. Circumstantial support only: Ron Shurts is publicly identified as Amplify's Co-Founder and sits on the Ashton Thomas Advisory Board per a September 2023 press release. Suggestive but not confirmatory — remains unresolved after genuine effort.
firm_note.source: Arizona Corporation Commission filing via bizprofile.net (bizprofile.net/az/scottsdale/amplify-ventures-group-llc); GlobeNewswire press release, 'Ashton Thomas Private Wealth Joins RedBird Capital's Arax Investment Partners' (globenewswire.com/news-release/2023/09/13/2742366); amplifyplatform.com leadership page

Aaron Paul Brodt.bio_note: Founder and CEO of Amplify and of Ashton Thomas Private Wealth, the RIA he grew to nearly $11B in AUM before it joined Arax/RedBird Capital in 2023. Began his career as an oil trader for Tosco (now ConocoPhillips) before becoming a financial advisor and portfolio manager for a multifamily office. Holds the CIMA (Certified Investment Management Analyst) designation, taught in conjunction with the Wharton School. Played NCAA Division I basketball at New Mexico State University. Married to Heidi Brodt; they live in Scottsdale with their two sons.
Aaron Paul Brodt.bio_source: BusinessWire press release, 'Amplify Achieves Record Growth, Doubles Headcount and Surpasses $18 Billion in AUM' (businesswire.com/news/home/20250204263917/en/Amplify-Achieves-Record-Growth); corroborated by LinkedIn profile 'Aaron Brodt CIMA - Ashton Thomas Private Wealth'

Peggy Jolen Garcia.bio_note: Goes professionally by 'Jolen Garcia.' Chief Compliance Officer at Amplify with roughly two decades of experience in wealth management. Prior to Amplify she was Director of Investment Operations at Ashton Thomas Private Wealth and earlier held a compliance role at GenSpring Family Offices.
Peggy Jolen Garcia.bio_source: Amplify leadership page (amplifyplatform.com/about-us/#leadership), cross-checked against an independent professional-network profile aggregator (Wiza) showing her prior role at Ashton Thomas Private Wealth

David T. Hatfield.bio_note: Chief Technology Officer of Amplify; architected the platform's data infrastructure around an 'AI-native data lake' approach roughly eight years ago, ahead of the industry trend. Holds a Master of Science in Information Management from Arizona State University and has over a decade of experience deploying enterprise information management and analytics solutions. Based in the Gilbert, AZ area.
David T. Hatfield.bio_source: The Wealth Advisor, 'How Amplify Platform Aims to Give Advisors Their Business—and Their Sundays—Back' (thewealthadvisor.com), an independent trade publication profiling his platform architecture decisions

Heidi Maria Brodt.bio_note: Confirmed to be Aaron Brodt's spouse (not merely a shared surname) — they reside in Scottsdale with their two sons per BusinessWire's company profile of Aaron. Business Manager at Ashton Thomas Private Wealth and Amplify; joined Ashton Thomas in 2015. Holds a Bachelor of Applied Science in Global Business (International Finance concentration) from Arizona State University. Earlier career was in medical-spa/practice business management before moving into financial services operations.
Heidi Maria Brodt.bio_source: LinkedIn profile 'Heidi Brodt - Business Manager at Ashton Thomas Private Wealth', corroborated by BusinessWire's Amplify company profile confirming her marriage to Aaron Brodt

Jason Charles Rowley.bio_note: Was Amplify's Chief of Staff and General Counsel before being promoted to President in March 2026. Spent 15+ years with Suns Legacy Partners, the Phoenix Suns' holding company, ultimately serving as President & CEO and driving the franchise from bottom-third in league revenue to #5, culminating in a $4 billion valuation and the franchise's 2023 sale. Holds a bachelor's degree and JD from the University of Arizona and served four years in the U.S. Navy as an Intelligence Specialist before law school.
Jason Charles Rowley.bio_source: citybiz, 'Amplify Appoints Jason Rowley As President And Kimberly Hill As Chief Revenue Officer' (citybiz.co/article/824488), an independent business news outlet, corroborated by BusinessWire/Morningstar syndication of the same announcement

firm_note.text: Wisdom Wealth Investment Advisors, LLC is an independently owned Phoenix-area advisory and financial consulting firm; its principals collectively bring more than 75 years of combined industry experience. The firm also operates tax services through an affiliated entity, JMFS, Inc.
firm_note.source: Firm website (wisdomwealth.solutions/about) corroborated by Indyfin's independent RIA directory profile

Joseph Damian Mcinerney.bio_note: Co-founder/Managing Member of Wisdom Wealth; has practiced since 1992 specializing in tax planning, wealth management, retirement planning, and risk management for individuals, families, and small business owners. Holds CFP (1999) and Enrolled Agent (EA, 1999) credentials — the EA license authorizes him to represent taxpayers before the IRS in all 50 states — plus a Master of Personal Financial Planning (MPAS, College for Financial Planning, 2014) and a Master of Science in Taxation (Golden Gate University, 2007).
Joseph Damian Mcinerney.bio_source: U.S. News & World Report Financial Advisors directory profile (money.usnews.com/financial-advisors/advisor/joseph-mcinerney-2344141), an independent professional directory; his FINRA BrokerCheck report independently corroborates licensing history

Blake Lepage Bottle.bio_note: Co-founder/Managing Member and Chief Compliance Officer of Wisdom Wealth. Entered the financial services business in 1990 and has operated as an independent advisor since 1998; spent over two decades affiliated with Concourse Financial Group Securities/ProEquities (1998-2022) before/alongside founding Wisdom Wealth in 2014. Earned the Chartered Financial Consultant (ChFC) designation in 1997. Holds Series 63 and 65 licenses and is a past president of the Phoenix chapter of the Society of Financial Service Professionals.
Blake Lepage Bottle.bio_source: SmartAdvisorMatch independent advisor-network directory profile, cross-checked against his SEC IAPD report (adviserinfo.sec.gov/individual/summary/2065531)

firm_note.text: Pinnacle Peak Private Client Group, LLC, founded in 2016 and based in Scottsdale, provides portfolio management and financial planning to high-net-worth individuals, families, business owners, trusts, and charitable organizations, with a particular focus on active and retired federal employees. IMPORTANT: in a deal announced March 2026, the firm ($460M AUM) joined Ashton Thomas Private Wealth (part of Arax Investment Partners/RedBird Capital) — this firm is likely no longer operating independently and may not be a viable acquisition target.
firm_note.source: GlobeNewswire press release, 'Arax Adds Pinnacle Peak Private Client Group to Ashton Thomas' (globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/03/05/3250072), an independent wire service report

Brian Patrick Jack.bio_note: Partner, Managing Director and Chief Compliance Officer of Pinnacle Peak; over 22 years of financial markets experience. Previously a Financial Advisor at Ameriprise Financial and Vice President, Investments at HRBFA (H.D. Vest/HR Block Financial Advisors). Holds Series 63 and 65 licenses. Following the March 2026 Ashton Thomas transaction, moved into a Director/Partner, Private Wealth Advisor role there; publicly quoted in the deal announcement.
Brian Patrick Jack.bio_source: GlobeNewswire press release, 'Arax Adds Pinnacle Peak Private Client Group to Ashton Thomas' (globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/03/05/3250072), independent wire service with a direct quote attributed to him; career history corroborated by ZoomInfo

Matthew Joseph Figueroa.bio_note: Managing Director (Partner) at Pinnacle Peak with 26 years of experience; holds Series 63 and 65 licenses, registered to serve clients in Arizona and Texas. Publicly quoted in the March 2026 Ashton Thomas acquisition announcement. A self-described diehard Pittsburgh Steelers fan who enjoys golf, CrossFit, and hiking with his wife Melissa and their two children.
Matthew Joseph Figueroa.bio_source: GlobeNewswire press release, 'Arax Adds Pinnacle Peak Private Client Group to Ashton Thomas' (globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/03/05/3250072), independent wire service with a direct quote attributed to him

Teresa Flores.bio_note: Partner and Operations Manager at Pinnacle Peak, in the financial services industry since 1995; before Pinnacle Peak worked as a registered sales assistant, transition specialist, and senior field office team leader across four offices. An avid snowboarder, rock-climber, and terrain-racer, and a self-described big Arizona Cardinals fan. Following the March 2026 Ashton Thomas transaction, moved into a Senior Registered Associate, Private Wealth Client Services role there.
Teresa Flores.bio_source: GlobeNewswire press release, 'Arax Adds Pinnacle Peak Private Client Group to Ashton Thomas' (globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/03/05/3250072), independent wire service confirming her new role, corroborated by SmartAdvisorMatch independent advisor directory profile

firm_note.text: Triton Wealth Management, PLLC is a Sun City, AZ-based RIA founded in 2018. Equally owned by four Managing Members — Cody Ashton, David Dorsey, Michael Bird, and Chad Mitton — all former wirehouse/independent-channel advisors (Edward Jones, Raymond James, Charles Schwab custody) who consolidated their practices into a fee-based fiduciary firm.

Cody Lee Ashton.bio_note: Managing Member, CCO, and co-founder. 17+ years in the industry (licensed advisor since 2008), with prior experience at Edward Jones, Apple Computer, and Raymond James Financial Services before co-founding Triton. Holds a bachelor's in information systems management from Weber State University. Raised in Lyman, Wyoming; lives in Surprise, AZ with wife Brooke and three sons; active in church service, the Lions Club, and youth sports coaching.
Cody Lee Ashton.bio_source: SmartAdvisorMatch advisor profile (smartadvisormatch.com/advisor-network/arizona/cody-ashton-5493790) corroborating firm bio

David Lee Dorsey.bio_note: Managing Member and co-founder. 24 years in the industry; born and raised in Beaumont, TX, attended Lamar University, then built his practice at Edward Jones Investments in Arizona, becoming a top producer there before co-founding Triton. Holds Series 63 and 66 licenses, registered in AZ and TX. Married to Kristen with four children; enjoys gourmet cooking, astronomy, fly fishing, and travel.
David Lee Dorsey.bio_source: GetWarmer advisor profile (getwarmer.com/advisors/david-dorsey) corroborating firm bio

Michael Clawson Bird.bio_note: Managing Member and co-founder. 16 years in the industry with prior roles at Edward Jones Investments and Raymond James Financial Services. Holds a bachelor's degree from Brigham Young University and an MBA from San Francisco State University. Married to Donna, with three adult (married) children; enjoys travel, golf, and sailing.
Michael Clawson Bird.bio_source: Indyfin advisor profile (indyfin.com/financial-advisor/arizona/sun-city/michael-bird-5705865) corroborating firm bio

William Chad Mitton.bio_note: Managing Member and co-founder. 15 years in investment advisory; has mentored newer and veteran advisors across Arizona's West Valley. Fluent Spanish speaker who completed a two-year missionary service in Honduras; married to Adrianna with five children; coaches varsity football at a local high school.
William Chad Mitton.bio_source: Firm bio (tritonwealthmanagement.com/chad) — no independent profile beyond aggregator mirrors (U.S. News, Indyfin) that only restate firm/CRD data with no added biographical detail was found despite genuine search effort

firm_note.text: Financial Life Planners is a Tempe, AZ RIA founded in 2001 (some sources say 2003) serving roughly 298 client relationships. Co-owned by founder Cynthia Fick and partner Gina Giachetti Wight, both fiduciaries with 50+ combined years in the industry.

Cynthia Kay Fick.bio_note: Founder, President, and majority owner, with 31+ years in finance and investing. Author of 'The Sisterhood of Money: The Art of Creating Wealth from Your Heart,' a narrative-style book built around the six-stage Financial Life Planning process she developed and taught to hundreds of women in seminars. Frequently featured in local media — The Arizona Republic, Ahwatukee Foothills News, and Phoenix-market TV shows — as a go-to voice on women and money.
Cynthia Kay Fick.bio_source: cpapracticeadvisor.com coverage of her book launch plus Amazon/Barnes & Noble listings for 'The Sisterhood of Money' (independent of the firm website)

Gina Giachetti Wight.bio_note: Partner and Co-Owner, Registered Investment Advisor with 15+ years in financial services. Prior to Financial Life Planners, she was Vice President, Branch Manager at Morgan Stanley. Holds Series 63 and 65 licenses and is registered to advise in Arizona, California, and Texas.
Gina Giachetti Wight.bio_source: ZoomInfo profile corroborating firm team page

Janet Lynn Messer.bio_note: Chief Compliance Officer, joined the firm 07/2025. Genuine search effort (web search, LinkedIn, SEC/CRD-oriented queries) found no independent source specific to this Janet Messer at Financial Life Planners — a same-named compliance professional appears at an unrelated firm (AdvisorLaw, Colorado-based), but nothing ties that profile to this individual, so it is not used.
Janet Lynn Messer.bio_source: None — firm website team page only; no independent source located despite genuine effort

Matt Fick.bio_note: Listed on the firm website as Investment Advisor Representative / Junior Partner. No CRD or ownership record on file, and no independent source (LinkedIn, ZoomInfo, advisor directories, press) could be found naming a 'Matt Fick' at Financial Life Planners — he does not appear in ZoomInfo's employee directory or any advisor-matching sites alongside Cynthia Fick and Gina Wight. Given the shared surname, a family relationship to Cynthia Fick is plausible but could not be confirmed independently.
Matt Fick.bio_source: None — firm website only; no independent source located despite genuine effort

firm_note.text: Rovin Capital, LLC is a Mesa, AZ (with Lehi, UT office) RIA with $849M-$917M AUM, founded 2010. IMPORTANT: in February 2026, Boston-based CW Advisors (a subsidiary of Osaic Holdings) announced its acquisition of Rovin Capital to expand its western U.S. footprint — this firm is likely no longer operating independently and may not be a viable acquisition target.

Markell Anthony Staffieri.bio_note: CEO and President of Rovin Capital (indirect owner via Snow River/Snowy River Corp). Joined the financial industry in 2008; holds Chartered Financial Consultant (ChFC) and Certified Wealth Strategist (CWS) designations. Notable pre-finance career: competitive football player who signed as a free agent with the Philadelphia Eagles. Grew up in Solana Beach, CA; served a two-year church mission in South Carolina; is an Eagle Scout; married with five children. Publicly quoted on the CW Advisors acquisition: 'Joining CWA allows us to elevate the service we provide to our clients with enhanced client solutions and access to expanded resources.'
Markell Anthony Staffieri.bio_source: Pulse2 acquisition coverage (pulse2.com/cw-advisors-acquisition-of-849-million-firm-rovin-capital) quoting Staffieri directly, corroborated by Rovin's own team bio page

Kimball Eric Pierce.bio_note: COO, Partner & Wealth Advisor at Rovin Capital (indirect owner via Blue King Momentum Inc), 18+ years in finance. Career path: started as a broker with Edward Jones (2005), moved to Morgan Stanley (2006), took a two-year religious mission in Quetzaltenango, Guatemala, then rejoined Morgan Stanley (2009) before being recruited to Goldman Sachs (2010), where he managed hedge fund client relationships and supported prime brokerage trading. Holds a B.S. in Business Management from Brigham Young University and the ChFC designation.
Kimball Eric Pierce.bio_source: LinkedIn profile, K. Eric Pierce, ChFC, corroborating Rovin's team bio page

Whitnite Pierce.bio_note: Co-owner of Blue King Momentum Inc (an indirect Rovin Capital owner) alongside Kimball Eric Pierce. Shared surname strongly suggests a spousal/family relationship, but genuine search effort (web search, LinkedIn, corporate filings) turned up no independent source confirming the relationship or any biographical/career detail for this individual.
Whitnite Pierce.bio_source: None found — appears only in RIA ownership records alongside Kimball Pierce; no independent biographical source located despite genuine effort

Matthew Ds Staffieri.bio_note: Chief Compliance Officer at Rovin Capital as of 2026; has also been an Investment Advisor at the firm since 2013 (12+ years), holds a Series 66. Separately serves as president of Artegius Capital, Inc., a fund-management investment firm. Shared surname with Markell Staffieri suggests a possible family tie, but no independent source confirms a relationship between them.
Matthew Ds Staffieri.bio_source: Wealthminder advisor profile and Indyfin profile, both independent of the firm website
